description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Cost and Reliability Score for three different models, comparing their performance across a range of costs. The x-axis is labeled "Cost", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 10, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score", has a linear scale, ranges from 30 to 90, and has tick labels at intervals of 10 and additional ticks at 50 and other unlabeled values are not considered. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circular markers and a solid style, starting at a reliability score of approximately 84 at a cost of 0, decreasing steadily to around 74 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is depicted by a red line with circular markers and a solid style, beginning at a reliability score of about 85 at a cost of 0, and declining to roughly 72 at a cost of 10. The GPT-4 model is shown as a yellow line with circular markers and a solid style, starting at a reliability score of 90 at a cost of 0, and dropping sharply to approximately 38 at a cost of 10.
